verdicts.reason: A just shrinks the portrait stack into the centre of the banner: the headline is small, the cat illustration is tiny, and both side thirds are dead purple, so it doesn't fit the wide format at all. B rearranges it properly as a left-to-right banner, with a large, readable headline on the left and the cats bleeding off the bottom on the right as in the original. Its flaws are minor: 'AND' sits alone on its own line, and the cat group's top runs close to the top edge, with a slightly tight gap between the text and the image.
